test_title: PYST 27: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 20th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:

The scroll displayed the symbol of a __**tau**__.

options.text: The Greek tau was inscribed carefully.
The monk carved a wooden tau.

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. Currency markets tracked tau values .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The question asks us to identify the sentence containing the **homonym** of the highlighted word "tau."
 
• A **homonym** is a word that has the same spelling or pronunciation as another word but has a different meaning.
 
• The word "tau" in the original sentence refers to a **Greek letter.**
 
• In **Option 3**, the word "tau" is used in the context of currency markets, where it refers to a statistical measure related to financial trends, not the Greek letter. Hence, it is a homonym of the original use.

Correct sentence: *Currency markets tracked tau values*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Homonyms** can take various forms:

 
 
• **Homophones:** Words that sound the same but have different spellings and meanings (e.g., "pair" and "pear").
 
• **Homographs:** Words that are spelled the same but have different meanings and sometimes different pronunciations (e.g., "lead" as a metal and "lead" as to guide).
 
 
 
• The word "tau" in this context is a **homograph,** as its spelling remains the same but it has different meanings in different contexts.
